result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with institutional architecture and broad, well-maintained sidewalks. A marked zebra crosswalk is present, but it lacks active traffic control or warning signage, and the pavement within the crossing area is noticeably degraded.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant patching and cracking within the crosswalk area create an uneven surface and potential trip hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Active Traffic Control
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks signals, stop signs, or warning signage to regulate vehicle flow or alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the crossing point across the roadway

interventions.title: Install Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt within the crosswalk to provide a smooth, level surface for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install vertical 'Pedestrian Crossing' signs (W11-2) to improve the visibility of the crossing to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a curb ramp with tactile paving. While sidewalks and street lighting are present, the crossing lacks active signalization or traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds on the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal or stop sign.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Potential High Vehicle Speeds
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway geometry may encourage vehicle speeds higher than appropriate for an urban pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While the environment includes sidewalks and traffic signal control, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without a median refuge.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge island.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. However, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without the protection of a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island or median.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to turning motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
